description: Use this after search_listings when the user wants the full details of one Homejourney listing, such as its description, size, tenure, furnishing, availability, nearest MRT, nearby schools, the MRT stations, primary schools by 1 km and 2 km band, secondary schools, supermarkets, hawker centres and CHAS clinics near it, and Homejourney link. Never returns owner or agent contact details.
name: get_listing_details

bookingUrl.description: Where the user asks for a viewing.

depositMonths.description: Details only, for an owner rental: the security deposit in months of rent, as the owner stated it. Null when not stated; partner listings carry none.

facing.description: Details only: which way the main windows face, as the owner states it (N, NE, E, SE, S, SW, W or NW).

floorplans.description: Details only: published floor plan image URLs.

hdbFlatType.description: Search results only, for an HDB flat: its flat type, such as 4-room or executive, inferred from its block's resale records and its size.

hdbLease.description: Details and compare, for an HDB flat: its block's lease start year, the lease left this month and the block's age in years, as in lease; kept for earlier clients. Null when unknown.

imageLabels.description: One per image, in order: the tag to show with an owner's edited photo, or null for an unedited one.

lease.description: Search, compare and details, for every home: its tenure, the lease left this month and its age from TOP, as the listing page shows them. An HDB flat's lease comes from its block's resale records; a condo, EC or landed home's from URA's records of its land lease, not its TOP. remainingLabel is 'Lease start not confirmed' for a leasehold whose start is not found, and null for freehold and 999-year homes. Null when nothing is known.

startYear.description: The year the lease began; null when not confirmed.

tenureLabel.description: Such as 99-year lease from 2000, or Freehold; null when the tenure is not known.

listedAt.description: When the listing was first shown publicly.

nearbyPlaces.description: Details only: the places the listing page shows near the block. mrtStations (code, name, walkMinutes), primarySchoolsWithin1Km and primarySchools1To2Km (the Primary 1 registration bands), secondarySchools, supermarkets, hawkerCentres (within 2 km) and clinics (CHAS clinics within 1 km, type gp or dental), the last three with name, place and walkMinutes, each with distanceKm. Distances are straight-line from the block and walks are estimates; for Primary 1 registration, the user checks the exact distance on OneMap SchoolQuery.

price.description: SGD; monthly rent for a rental.

priceReason.description: Details only: the owner's own words on why the home is priced as it is.

renovationYear.description: Details only: the year the owner last renovated.

seller.description: Details only, for an owner listing: whether the owner verified with Singpass, their weekly viewing hours (Singapore time, weekday 0 is Sunday; empty when none are open), and how many minutes they usually take to first answer a viewing request (null until they have answered at least 3).

storeyRange.description: Details only: HDB's three-storey band, such as 13 to 15, never the exact storey.

title: Get Homejourney listing details
